// src/modules/identity/service.ts
import { db } from "../../shared/db.js";
import { hashPassword, verifyPassword } from "../../shared/auth/password.js";
import { signToken, type JwtPayload } from "../../shared/auth/jwt.js";
import { AppError } from "../../shared/errors.js";
import type { RegisterInput, LoginInput, UpdateProfileInput, UpdatePasswordInput } from "./schema.js";

export type PublicUser = {
  id: string;
  name: string | null;
  email: string;
  role: "CUSTOMER" | "ADMIN";
  image: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  emailVerified: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

function toPublic(user: {
  id: string;
  name: string | null;
  email: string;
  role: "CUSTOMER" | "ADMIN";
  image: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  emailVerified: Date | null;
  createdAt: Date;
}): PublicUser {
  return {
    id: user.id,
    name: user.name,
    email: user.email,
    role: user.role,
    image: user.image,
    phone: user.phone,
    emailVerified: user.emailVerified?.toISOString() ?? null,
    createdAt: user.createdAt.toISOString(),
  };
}

export async function register(input: RegisterInput): Promise<{
  user: PublicUser;
  token: string;
}> {
  const existing = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: input.email },
    select: { id: true },
  });

  if (existing) {
    throw new AppError(
      "An account with this email already exists",
      409,
      "EMAIL_TAKEN",
    );
  }

  const passwordHash = await hashPassword(input.password);

  const created = await db.user.create({
    data: {
      name: input.name,
      email: input.email,
      passwordHash,
      phone: input.phone ?? null,
      image: input.image ?? null,
      role: "CUSTOMER",
    },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      email: true,
      role: true,
      image: true,
      phone: true,
      emailVerified: true,
      createdAt: true,
    },
  });

  const payload: JwtPayload = {
    userId: created.id,
    email: created.email,
    role: created.role,
  };
  const token = signToken(payload);

  return { user: toPublic(created), token };
}

export async function login(input: LoginInput): Promise<{
  user: PublicUser;
  token: string;
}> {
  const found = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { email: input.email },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      email: true,
      role: true,
      image: true,
      phone: true,
      emailVerified: true,
      createdAt: true,
      passwordHash: true,
    },
  });

  if (!found || !found.passwordHash) {
    throw new AppError("Invalid email or password", 401, "INVALID_CREDENTIALS");
  }

  const ok = await verifyPassword(input.password, found.passwordHash);
  if (!ok) {
    throw new AppError("Invalid email or password", 401, "INVALID_CREDENTIALS");
  }

  const { passwordHash: _hash, ...rest } = found;
  const payload: JwtPayload = {
    userId: rest.id,
    email: rest.email,
    role: rest.role,
  };
  const token = signToken(payload);

  return { user: toPublic(rest), token };
}

export async function getSessionUser(userId: string): Promise<PublicUser> {
  const found = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      email: true,
      role: true,
      image: true,
      phone: true,
      emailVerified: true,
      createdAt: true,
    },
  });

  if (!found) {
    throw new AppError("User not found", 404, "USER_NOT_FOUND");
  }

  return toPublic(found);
}

// â”€â”€ Update profile â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

export async function updateProfile(
  userId: string,
  input: UpdateProfileInput,
): Promise<PublicUser> {
  const existing = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { id: userId } });
  if (!existing) {
    throw new AppError("User not found", 404, "USER_NOT_FOUND");
  }

  if (input.email !== existing.email) {
    const taken = await db.user.findUnique({
      where: { email: input.email },
      select: { id: true },
    });
    if (taken) {
      throw new AppError(
        "An account with this email already exists",
        409,
        "EMAIL_TAKEN",
      );
    }
  }

  const updated = await db.user.update({
    where: { id: userId },
    data: {
      name: input.name,
      email: input.email,
      phone: input.phone ?? null,
      image: input.image === undefined ? existing.image : input.image,
    },
    select: {
      id: true, name: true, email: true, role: true, image: true,
      phone: true, emailVerified: true, createdAt: true,
    },
  });

  return toPublic(updated);
}

export async function updatePassword(
  userId: string,
  input: UpdatePasswordInput,
): Promise<void> {
  const found = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: userId },
    select: { passwordHash: true },
  });
  if (!found) throw new AppError("User not found", 404, "USER_NOT_FOUND");

  if (!found.passwordHash) {
    throw new AppError(
      "This account uses Google sign-in. Password cannot be changed here.",
      400, "OAUTH_USER",
    );
  }

  const ok = await verifyPassword(input.currentPassword, found.passwordHash);
  if (!ok) throw new AppError("Current password is incorrect", 401, "INVALID_PASSWORD");

  const newHash = await hashPassword(input.newPassword);
  await db.user.update({ where: { id: userId }, data: { passwordHash: newHash } });
}

// â”€â”€ Admin: user management â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€

export type AdminUserRow = {
  id: string;
  name: string | null;
  email: string;
  role: "CUSTOMER" | "ADMIN";
  image: string | null;
  phone: string | null;
  emailVerified: string | null;
  deletedAt: string | null;
  createdAt: string;
};

export async function listUsers(): Promise<AdminUserRow[]> {
  const users = await db.user.findMany({
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    select: {
      id: true,
      name: true,
      email: true,
      role: true,
      image: true,
      phone: true,
      emailVerified: true,
      deletedAt: true,
      createdAt: true,
    },
  });

  return users.map((u) => ({
    id: u.id,
    name: u.name,
    email: u.email,
    role: u.role,
    image: u.image,
    phone: u.phone,
    emailVerified: u.emailVerified ? u.emailVerified.toISOString() : null,
    deletedAt: u.deletedAt ? u.deletedAt.toISOString() : null,
    createdAt: u.createdAt.toISOString(),
  }));
}

export async function adminDeleteUser(
  targetUserId: string,
  actingAdminId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (targetUserId === actingAdminId) {
    throw new AppError(
      "You cannot delete your own account from here",
      400,
      "SELF_DELETE",
    );
  }

  const target = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: targetUserId },
    select: { id: true, role: true, deletedAt: true },
  });
  if (!target) {
    throw new AppError("User not found", 404, "USER_NOT_FOUND");
  }
  if (target.deletedAt) {
    // Already deleted â€” treat as success
    return;
  }

  // Soft-delete the same way the self-service flow does
  await db.user.update({
    where: { id: targetUserId },
    data: {
      deletedAt: new Date(),
      email: `deleted-${targetUserId}@ted-nomex.invalid`,
      name: "Deleted User",
      phone: null,
      image: null,
      passwordHash: null,
      emailVerified: null,
    },
  });

  await db.session.deleteMany({ where: { userId: targetUserId } });
}

// src/modules/leads/enquiries/service.ts
import { db } from "../../../shared/db.js";
import { AppError } from "../../../shared/errors.js";
import type { CreateEnquiryInput, UpdateEnquiryInput, ListEnquiriesQuery } from "./schema.js";

export async function createEnquiry(input: CreateEnquiryInput, userId?: string) {
  return db.enquiry.create({
    data: {
      name: input.name, email: input.email, phone: input.phone ?? null,
      subject: input.subject ?? null, message: input.message,
      userId: userId ?? null,
    },
  });
}

export async function listEnquiries(query: ListEnquiriesQuery) {

// src/modules/shop/orders/schema.ts

// src/modules/shop/orders/service.ts
import { db } from "../../../shared/db.js";
import { AppError } from "../../../shared/errors.js";
import type { CheckoutInput, UpdateOrderInput, ListOrdersQuery } from "./schema.js";

const orderInclude = { items: true } as const;

export async function validateCartAndGetProducts(input: CheckoutInput) {
  const productIds = input.items.map((i) => i.productId);

  const products = await db.product.findMany({
    where: { id: { in: productIds }, published: true },
  });

  if (products.length !== productIds.length) {
    throw new AppError("One or more products are no longer available", 400, "PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE");
  }

  const productMap = new Map(products.map((p) => [p.id, p]));
  let subtotal = 0;
  const lineItems: {
    productId: string; title: string; price: number; quantity: number;
    image: string | null; stock: number;
  }[] = [];

  for (const item of input.items) {
    const product = productMap.get(item.productId)!;
    if (product.stock < item.quantity) {
      throw new AppError(
        `Not enough stock for "${product.name}" (only ${product.stock} left)`,
        400, "OUT_OF_STOCK",
      );
    }
    const price = Number(product.price);
    subtotal += price * item.quantity;
    lineItems.push({
      productId: product.id, title: product.name, price,
      quantity: item.quantity, image: product.images[0] ?? null, stock: product.stock,
    });
  }

  return { lineItems, subtotal };
}

export async function createOrder(input: CheckoutInput, userId: string | null) {
  const { lineItems, subtotal } = await validateCartAndGetProducts(input);
  const shipping = 0;
  const total = subtotal + shipping;

  const order = await db.order.create({
    data: {
      userId,
      email: input.shipping.email,
      status: "PENDING",
      currency: "GHS",
      subtotal,
      total,
      shippingName: input.shipping.name,
      shippingAddress: input.shipping.address,
      shippingCity: input.shipping.city,
      shippingRegion: input.shipping.region ?? null,
      shippingCountry: input.shipping.country,
      shippingNotes: input.shipping.notes ?? null,
      items: {
        create: lineItems.map((li) => ({
          productId: li.productId, title: li.title, price: li.price,
          quantity: li.quantity, image: li.image,
        })),
      },
    },
    include: orderInclude,
  });

  return { order, lineItems };
}

export async function markOrderPaid(
  orderId: string, stripeSessionId: string, stripePaymentId: string | null,
  cardLast4: string | null, cardBrand: string | null,
) {
  const existing = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id: orderId }, select: { status: true } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError("Order not found", 404, "NOT_FOUND");
  if (existing.status === "PAID" || existing.status === "FULFILLED") return;

  await db.order.update({
    where: { id: orderId },
    data: {
      status: "PAID", paymentStatus: "PAID",
      stripeSession: stripeSessionId, stripePaymentId, cardLast4, cardBrand,
    },
  });

  const items = await db.orderItem.findMany({
    where: { orderId },
    select: { productId: true, quantity: true },
  });

  for (const item of items) {
    if (!item.productId) continue;
    await db.product.update({
      where: { id: item.productId },
      data: { stock: { decrement: item.quantity } },
    });
  }
}

export async function markOrderFailed(orderId: string) {
  await db.order.update({
    where: { id: orderId },
    data: { paymentStatus: "FAILED" },
  });
}

export async function getOrderById(id: string) {
  const order = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id }, include: orderInclude });
  if (!order) throw new AppError("Order not found", 404, "NOT_FOUND");
  return order;
}

export async function getOrderByStripeSession(sessionId: string) {
  return db.order.findFirst({
    where: { stripeSession: sessionId },
    include: orderInclude,
  });
}

export async function listMyOrders(userId: string) {
  return db.order.findMany({
    where: { userId },
    include: orderInclude,
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });
}

export async function listAllOrders(query: ListOrdersQuery) {
  const where: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (query.status !== "all") where.status = query.status;

  return db.order.findMany({
    where,
    include: { ...orderInclude, user: { select: { id: true, name: true, email: true } } },
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
    take: query.limit, skip: query.offset,
  });
}

export async function updateOrder(id: string, input: UpdateOrderInput) {
  const existing = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError("Order not found", 404, "NOT_FOUND");
  return db.order.update({ where: { id }, data: input, include: orderInclude });
}

export async function deleteOrder(id: string) {
  const existing = await db.order.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError("Order not found", 404, "NOT_FOUND");
  await db.order.delete({ where: { id } });
  return { ok: true };
}

FILE: src\modules\shop\orders\stripe.ts

// src/modules/shop/orders/stripe.ts
import Stripe from "stripe";
import { env } from "../../../shared/env.js";

if (!env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY) {
  throw new Error("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY not set — cannot initialize Stripe");
}

export const stripe = new Stripe(env.STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, {
  apiVersion: "2026-10-28.endive",
});

// ── Currency conversion (site = GHS, Stripe = configured charge currency) ──
// Site displays GHS prices to the customer. The order in DB stays GHS.
// Stripe session charges in STRIPE_CHARGE_CURRENCY (default: usd).
// Update STRIPE_GHS_TO_USD_RATE when the exchange rate drifts significantly.
const CHARGE_CURRENCY = (process.env.STRIPE_CHARGE_CURRENCY ?? "usd").toLowerCase();
const GHS_TO_USD_RATE = Number(process.env.STRIPE_GHS_TO_USD_RATE ?? "0.065");

function convertPriceToChargeAmount(ghsPrice: number): number {
  // Returns the smallest unit for the target currency (cents for USD/EUR/GBP).
  const usd = ghsPrice * GHS_TO_USD_RATE;
  return Math.max(50, Math.round(usd * 100)); // Stripe minimum = 50 cents
}

export async function createCheckoutSession(params: {
  orderId: string;
  lineItems: { title: string; price: number; quantity: number; image: string | null }[];
  customerEmail: string;
  currency: string;
  originUrl: string;
}) {
  // Convert every line item from GHS (site price) to the charge currency.
  const line_items: Stripe.Checkout.SessionCreateParams.LineItem[] =
    params.lineItems.map((item) => ({
      price_data: {
        currency: CHARGE_CURRENCY,
        product_data: {
          name: item.title,
          ...(item.image ? { images: [item.image] } : {}),
          description: `Original price: ${item.price.toLocaleString()} GHS`,
        },
        unit_amount: convertPriceToChargeAmount(item.price),
      },
      quantity: item.quantity,
    }));

  const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.create({
    mode: "payment",
    line_items,
    customer_email: params.customerEmail,
    success_url: `${params.originUrl}/checkout/success?session_id={CHECKOUT_SESSION_ID}`,
    cancel_url: `${params.originUrl}/checkout/cancelled`,
    metadata: {
      orderId: params.orderId,
      originalCurrency: params.currency,
      conversionRate: String(GHS_TO_USD_RATE),
    },
  });

  return session;
}

FILE: src\modules\shop\orders\webhooks.ts
════════════════════════════════════════════
// src/modules/shop/orders/webhooks.ts
import { Router, raw } from "express";
import Stripe from "stripe";
import { stripe } from "./stripe.js";
import { env } from "../../../shared/env.js";
import { logger } from "../../../shared/logger.js";
import { markOrderPaid, markOrderFailed } from "./service.js";

export const stripeWebhookRouter = Router();

stripeWebhookRouter.post("/", raw({ type: "application/json" }), async (req, res) => {
  const signature = req.headers["stripe-signature"];

  if (!signature || typeof signature !== "string") {
    return res.status(400).json({ error: "Missing stripe-signature" });
  }
  if (!env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET) {
    logger.error("STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET not configured");
    return res.status(500).json({ error: "Webhook secret missing" });
  }

  let event: Stripe.Event;
  try {
    event = stripe.webhooks.constructEvent(req.body, signature, env.STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET);
  } catch (err) {
    logger.error("Webhook signature verification failed", err);
    return res.status(400).json({ error: "Invalid signature" });
  }

  logger.info(`Stripe webhook: ${event.type}`);

  try {
    switch (event.type) {
      case "checkout.session.completed": {
        const session = event.data.object as Stripe.Checkout.Session;
        const orderId = session.metadata?.orderId;
        if (!orderId) {
          logger.warn("Stripe session missing orderId metadata");
          break;
        }

        const full = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(session.id, {
          expand: ["payment_intent"],
        });

        const paymentIntent = full.payment_intent as Stripe.PaymentIntent | null;
        const charge = paymentIntent?.latest_charge as Stripe.Charge | null;
        const card = charge?.payment_method_details?.card;

        await markOrderPaid(
          orderId, session.id, paymentIntent?.id ?? null,
          card?.last4 ?? null, card?.brand ?? null,
        );
        logger.info(`Order ${orderId} marked PAID`);
        break;
      }

      case "checkout.session.expired": {
        const session = event.data.object as Stripe.Checkout.Session;
        const orderId = session.metadata?.orderId;
        if (orderId) await markOrderFailed(orderId);
        break;
      }

      default:
        logger.debug(`Unhandled Stripe event: ${event.type}`);
    }

    res.json({ received: true });
  } catch (err) {
    logger.error("Webhook handler error", err);
    res.status(500).json({ error: "Webhook handler error" });
  }
});

// src/modules/shop/products/routes.ts
import { Router } from "express";
import { createProductSchema, updateProductSchema, listProductsQuerySchema } from "./schema.js";
import {
  listProducts, getProductBySlug, getProductById,
  createProduct, updateProduct, deleteProduct, getRelatedProducts,
} from "./service.js";
import { requireAdmin } from "../../identity/index.js";

export const productsRoutes = Router();

// Public
productsRoutes.get("/", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const query = listProductsQuerySchema.parse(req.query);
    const products = await listProducts(query);
    res.json(products);
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

// Related must come BEFORE /:slug
productsRoutes.get("/:slug/related", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const related = await getRelatedProducts(String(req.params.slug), 3);
    res.json(related);
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

// Admin â€” must come BEFORE /:slug
productsRoutes.get("/admin/all", requireAdmin, async (_req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const products = await listProducts({ published: "all", limit: 100, offset: 0 } as never);
    res.json(products);
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

productsRoutes.get("/admin/:id", requireAdmin, async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const product = await getProductById(String(req.params.id));
    res.json(product);
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

productsRoutes.post("/", requireAdmin, async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const input = createProductSchema.parse(req.body);
    const product = await createProduct(input);
    res.status(201).json(product);
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

productsRoutes.patch("/:id", requireAdmin, async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const input = updateProductSchema.parse(req.body);
    const product = await updateProduct(String(req.params.id), input);
    res.json(product);
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

productsRoutes.delete("/:id", requireAdmin, async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const result = await deleteProduct(String(req.params.id));
    res.json(result);
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

// Public by slug â€” MUST be last
productsRoutes.get("/:slug", async (req, res, next) => {
  try {
    const product = await getProductBySlug(String(req.params.slug));
    res.json(product);
  } catch (err) { next(err); }
});

// src/modules/shop/products/schema.ts
import { z } from "zod";

const arrayOfStrings = z
  .array(z.string().trim().min(1))
  .default([])
  .transform((arr) => arr.filter((s) => s.length > 0));

export const createProductSchema = z.object({
  slug: z.string().trim().min(3).max(120).regex(/^[a-z0-9-]+$/, "Slug must be lowercase, numbers, and hyphens only"),
  name: z.string().trim().min(3).max(200),
  description: z.string().trim().min(10),
  price: z.coerce.number().positive(),
  currency: z.string().trim().default("GHS"),
  stock: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).default(0),
  images: arrayOfStrings,
  category: z.string().trim().max(80).nullable().optional(),
  published: z.boolean().default(true),
});

export const updateProductSchema = createProductSchema.partial();

export const listProductsQuerySchema = z.object({
  published: z.enum(["true", "false", "all"]).default("true"),
  category: z.string().optional(),
  search: z.string().optional(),
  limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(100).default(50),
  offset: z.coerce.number().int().min(0).default(0),
});

export type CreateProductInput = z.infer<typeof createProductSchema>;
export type UpdateProductInput = z.infer<typeof updateProductSchema>;
export type ListProductsQuery = z.infer<typeof listProductsQuerySchema>;

// src/modules/shop/products/service.ts
import { db } from "../../../shared/db.js";
import { AppError } from "../../../shared/errors.js";
import type { CreateProductInput, UpdateProductInput, ListProductsQuery } from "./schema.js";

export async function listProducts(query: ListProductsQuery) {
  const where: Record<string, unknown> = {};
  if (query.published !== "all") where.published = query.published === "true";
  if (query.category) where.category = query.category;

  if (query.search) {
    const q = query.search.trim();
    if (q.length > 0) {
      where.OR = [
        { name: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { description: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
        { category: { contains: q, mode: "insensitive" } },
      ];
    }
  }

  return db.product.findMany({
    where,
    orderBy: [{ createdAt: "desc" }],
    take: query.limit,
    skip: query.offset,
  });
}

export async function getProductBySlug(slug: string) {
  const product = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { slug } });
  if (!product) throw new AppError("Product not found", 404, "NOT_FOUND");
  if (!product.published) throw new AppError("Product not available", 404, "NOT_FOUND");
  return product;
}

export async function getProductById(id: string) {
  const product = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!product) throw new AppError("Product not found", 404, "NOT_FOUND");
  return product;
}

export async function createProduct(input: CreateProductInput) {
  const exists = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { slug: input.slug }, select: { id: true } });
  if (exists) throw new AppError(`A product with slug "${input.slug}" already exists`, 409, "SLUG_TAKEN");
  return db.product.create({ data: input });
}

export async function updateProduct(id: string, input: UpdateProductInput) {
  const existing = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError("Product not found", 404, "NOT_FOUND");

  if (input.slug && input.slug !== existing.slug) {
    const taken = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { slug: input.slug }, select: { id: true } });
    if (taken) throw new AppError(`A product with slug "${input.slug}" already exists`, 409, "SLUG_TAKEN");
  }

  return db.product.update({ where: { id }, data: input });
}

export async function deleteProduct(id: string) {
  const existing = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { id } });
  if (!existing) throw new AppError("Product not found", 404, "NOT_FOUND");
  await db.product.delete({ where: { id } });
  return { ok: true };
}

export async function getRelatedProducts(slug: string, limit = 3) {
  const current = await db.product.findUnique({ where: { slug } });
  if (!current) return [];

  const sameCategory = await db.product.findMany({
    where: { published: true, category: current.category, id: { not: current.id } },
    take: limit,
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });

  if (sameCategory.length >= limit) return sameCategory;

  const otherCount = limit - sameCategory.length;
  const excludeIds = [current.id, ...sameCategory.map((p) => p.id)];

  const others = await db.product.findMany({
    where: { published: true, id: { notIn: excludeIds } },
    take: otherCount,
    orderBy: { createdAt: "desc" },
  });

  return [...sameCategory, ...others];
}

// src/server.ts
import express from "express";
import cors from "cors";
import cookieParser from "cookie-parser";
import { env } from "./shared/env.js";
import { logger } from "./shared/logger.js";
import { pingDatabase } from "./shared/db.js";
import { errorHandler, notFoundHandler } from "./shared/errors.js";
import { identityRoutes } from "./modules/identity/index.js";
import { newsRoutes } from "./modules/cms/news/index.js";
import { servicesRoutes } from "./modules/cms/services/index.js";
import { estateRoutes } from "./modules/estate/index.js";
import { productsRoutes } from "./modules/shop/products/index.js";
import { quotesRoutes } from "./modules/leads/quotes/index.js";
import { enquiriesRoutes } from "./modules/leads/enquiries/index.js";
import { checkoutRoutes, ordersRoutes, stripeWebhookRouter } from "./modules/shop/orders/index.js";
import { mediaRoutes } from "./modules/media/index.js";

export function createApp() {
  const app = express();

  app.set("trust proxy", 1);
app.use("/api/webhooks/stripe", stripeWebhookRouter);
app.use(
    cors({
      origin: env.FRONTEND_URL,
      credentials: true,
      methods: ["GET", "POST", "PUT", "PATCH", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"],
      allowedHeaders: ["Content-Type", "Authorization"],
    }),
  );

  app.use(express.json({ limit: "5mb" }));
  app.use(express.urlencoded({ extended: true, limit: "5mb" }));
  app.use(cookieParser(env.COOKIE_SECRET));

  app.use((req, _res, next) => {
    logger.debug(`${req.method} ${req.originalUrl}`);
    next();
  });
 
  app.get("/health", async (_req, res) => {
    const dbOk = await pingDatabase();
    res.status(dbOk ? 200 : 503).json({
      status: dbOk ? "ok" : "degraded",
      db: dbOk ? "connected" : "unreachable",
      env: env.NODE_ENV,
      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    });
  });

  app.get("/", (_req, res) => {
    res.json({
      name: "Ted-Nomex API",
      version: "0.1.0",
      docs: "/health",
    });
  });

  // Module routes
  app.use("/api/auth", identityRoutes);
  app.use("/api/cms/news", newsRoutes);
  app.use("/api/cms/services", servicesRoutes);
  app.use("/api/estate", estateRoutes);
  app.use("/api/shop/products", productsRoutes);
  app.use("/api/quotes", quotesRoutes);
  app.use("/api/enquiries", enquiriesRoutes);
  app.use("/api/checkout", checkoutRoutes);
  app.use("/api/orders", ordersRoutes);
  app.use("/api/media", mediaRoutes);

  app.use(notFoundHandler);
  app.use(errorHandler);

  return app;
}

// src/shared/auth/cookies.ts
import type { Response } from "express";
import { isProd } from "../env.js";

export const SESSION_COOKIE = "ted_session";

const baseOptions = {
  httpOnly: true,
  secure: isProd,
  sameSite: (isProd ? "none" : "lax") as "none" | "lax",
  path: "/",
} as const;

export function setSessionCookie(res: Response, token: string) {
  res.cookie(SESSION_COOKIE, token, {
    ...baseOptions,
    maxAge: 7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000,
  });
}

export function clearSessionCookie(res: Response) {
  res.clearCookie(SESSION_COOKIE, baseOptions);
}

// src/shared/auth/jwt.ts
import jwt, { type SignOptions } from "jsonwebtoken";
import { env } from "../env.js";

export type JwtPayload = {
  userId: string;
  email: string;
  role: "CUSTOMER" | "ADMIN";
};

export function signToken(payload: JwtPayload): string {
  const options: SignOptions = {
    expiresIn: env.JWT_EXPIRES_IN as SignOptions["expiresIn"],
  };
  return jwt.sign(payload, env.JWT_SECRET, options);
}

export function verifyToken(token: string): JwtPayload | null {
  try {
    const decoded = jwt.verify(token, env.JWT_SECRET);
    if (typeof decoded !== "object" || decoded === null) return null;

    const { userId, email, role } = decoded as Record<string, unknown>;
    if (
      typeof userId !== "string" ||
      typeof email !== "string" ||
      (role !== "CUSTOMER" && role !== "ADMIN")
    ) {
      return null;
    }
    return { userId, email, role };
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

// src/shared/auth/middleware.ts
import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express";
import { SESSION_COOKIE } from "./cookies.js";
import { verifyToken, type JwtPayload } from "./jwt.js";
import { AppError } from "../errors.js";

declare global {
  namespace Express {
    interface Request {
      user?: JwtPayload;
    }
  }
}

function extractUser(req: Request): JwtPayload | null {
  const token = req.cookies?.[SESSION_COOKIE];
  if (!token || typeof token !== "string") return null;
  return verifyToken(token);
}

export function requireAuth(
  req: Request,
  _res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  const user = extractUser(req);
  if (!user) {
    return next(new AppError("Authentication required", 401, "UNAUTHENTICATED"));
  }
  req.user = user;
  next();
}

export function requireAdmin(
  req: Request,
  _res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  const user = extractUser(req);
  if (!user) {
    return next(new AppError("Authentication required", 401, "UNAUTHENTICATED"));
  }
  if (user.role !== "ADMIN") {
    return next(new AppError("Admin access required", 403, "FORBIDDEN"));
  }
  req.user = user;
  next();
}

export function optionalAuth(
  req: Request,
  _res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  const user = extractUser(req);
  if (user) req.user = user;
  next();
}

export async function rejectDeletedUsers(
  req: Request,
  _res: Response,
  next: NextFunction,
) {
  if (!req.user) return next();
  const { db } = await import("../db.js");
  const found = await db.user.findUnique({
    where: { id: req.user.userId },
    select: { deletedAt: true },
  });
  if (found?.deletedAt) {
    return next(new AppError("Account deleted", 401, "ACCOUNT_DELETED"));
  }
  next();
}

// src/shared/auth/password.ts
import bcrypt from "bcryptjs";

const ROUNDS = 12;

export async function hashPassword(plain: string): Promise<string> {
  return bcrypt.hash(plain, ROUNDS);
}

export async function verifyPassword(
  plain: string,
  hash: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  return bcrypt.compare(plain, hash);
}

// src/shared/errors.ts
import type { Request, Response, NextFunction } from "express";
import { ZodError } from "zod";
import { logger } from "./logger.js";
import { isProd } from "./env.js";

export class AppError extends Error {
  constructor(
    message: string,
    public statusCode: number = 400,
    public code: string = "BAD_REQUEST",
    public details?: unknown,
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "AppError";
  }
}

export function errorHandler(
  err: unknown,
  _req: Request,
  res: Response,
  _next: NextFunction,
) {
  if (err instanceof ZodError) {
    res.status(422).json({
      message: "Validation failed",
      code: "VALIDATION_ERROR",
      errors: err.flatten().fieldErrors,
    });
    return;
  }

  if (err instanceof AppError) {
    res.status(err.statusCode).json({
      message: err.message,
      code: err.code,
      ...(err.details ? { details: err.details } : {}),
    });
    return;
  }

  if (
    typeof err === "object" &&
    err !== null &&
    "code" in err &&
    (err as { code: string }).code === "P2025"
  ) {
    res.status(404).json({
      message: "Resource not found",
      code: "NOT_FOUND",
    });
    return;
  }

  logger.error("Unhandled error", err);

  res.status(500).json({
    message: isProd ? "Internal server error" : (err as Error).message,
    code: "INTERNAL_ERROR",
  });
}

export function notFoundHandler(req: Request, res: Response) {
  res.status(404).json({
    message: `Route not found: ${req.method} ${req.originalUrl}`,
    code: "ROUTE_NOT_FOUND",
  });
}

// src/shared/logger.ts
import { isProd } from "./env.js";

type Level = "info" | "warn" | "error" | "debug";

const COLORS: Record<Level, string> = {
  info: "\x1b[36m",
  warn: "\x1b[33m",
  error: "\x1b[31m",
  debug: "\x1b[90m",
};

const RESET = "\x1b[0m";

function log(level: Level, message: string, meta?: unknown) {
  const timestamp = new Date().toISOString();

  if (isProd) {
    console.log(
      JSON.stringify({
        timestamp,
        level,
        message,
        ...(meta && typeof meta === "object" ? { meta } : {}),
      }),
    );
    return;
  }

  const prefix = `${COLORS[level]}[${level.toUpperCase()}]${RESET}`;
  const time = `\x1b[90m${timestamp.split("T")[1].slice(0, 8)}${RESET}`;
  console.log(`${time} ${prefix} ${message}`);
  if (meta !== undefined) console.log(meta);
}

export const logger = {
  info: (msg: string, meta?: unknown) => log("info", msg, meta),
  warn: (msg: string, meta?: unknown) => log("warn", msg, meta),
  error: (msg: string, meta?: unknown) => log("error", msg, meta),
  debug: (msg: string, meta?: unknown) => log("debug", msg, meta),
};

// src/shared/mail.ts
import { Resend } from "resend";
import { env } from "./env.js";
import { logger } from "./logger.js";

let resend: Resend | null = null;

function getClient(): Resend | null {
  if (resend) return resend;
  if (!env.RESEND_API_KEY) {
    logger.warn("RESEND_API_KEY not set - emails will be logged instead of sent");
    return null;
  }
  resend = new Resend(env.RESEND_API_KEY);
  return resend;
}

type SendParams = {
  to: string;
  subject: string;
  html: string;
  text?: string;
};

export async function sendEmail(params: SendParams): Promise<void> {
  const client = getClient();
  const from = env.EMAIL_FROM ?? "Ted-Nomex <noreply@ted-nomex.com>";

  if (!client) {
    logger.info(`[DEV EMAIL] to=${params.to} subject="${params.subject}"`);
    logger.debug(params.text ?? params.html);
    return;
  }

  const { error } = await client.emails.send({
    from,
    to: params.to,
    subject: params.subject,
    html: params.html,
    text: params.text,
  });

  if (error) {
    logger.error("Resend send failed", error);
    throw new Error(`Failed to send email: ${error.message}`);
  }

  logger.info(`Email sent to ${params.to}: ${params.subject}`);
}

// src/shared/storage.ts
import { v2 as cloudinary } from "cloudinary";
import { env } from "./env.js";

if (
  !env.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME ||
  !env.CLOUDINARY_API_KEY ||
  !env.CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
) {
  console.warn(
    "âš ï¸  Cloudinary credentials not set â€” upload endpoint will fail",
  );
}

cloudinary.config({
  cloud_name: env.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME,
  api_key: env.CLOUDINARY_API_KEY,
  api_secret: env.CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET,
  secure: true,
});

export function generateUploadSignature(params: {
  folder?: string;
  publicId?: string;
  uploadPreset?: string;
}) {
  const timestamp = Math.round(Date.now() / 1000);
  const folder = params.folder ?? "ted-nomex";

  const toSign: Record<string, string | number> = {
    timestamp,
    folder,
  };

  if (params.uploadPreset) toSign.upload_preset = params.uploadPreset;
  if (params.publicId) toSign.public_id = params.publicId;

  const signature = cloudinary.utils.api_sign_request(
    toSign,
    env.CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET!,
  );

  return {
    signature,
    timestamp,
    folder,
    cloudName: env.CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME,
    apiKey: env.CLOUDINARY_API_KEY,
    ...(params.uploadPreset ? { uploadPreset: params.uploadPreset } : {}),
    ...(params.publicId ? { publicId: params.publicId } : {}),
  };
}

export async function deleteCloudinaryAsset(publicId: string) {
  try {
    await cloudinary.uploader.destroy(publicId);
  } catch (err) {
    console.warn("Failed to delete Cloudinary asset", publicId, err);
  }
}

export { cloudinary };
